entries.text: Yo, Champ! Coming to hit the books?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_c_01

entries.text: Yeah, exactly!
entries.label: kizuna_friend_c_select_01

entries.text: Nah, just passing through
entries.label: kizuna_friend_c_select_02

entries.text: Seriously? You’re already so good at everything\nelse—couldn’t you just slack off a bit? For me?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_c_02a

entries.text: What, you just felt like climbing all those stairs\nto train your legs or something?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_c_02b

entries.text: Oh, you wanna know why I’m here?\c\nUh...yeah. I’m still working on my own little\nTreasure Hunt—trying to find myself and all.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_c_03

entries.text: While I was here in the entrance hall, digging\nthrough my mom’s research reports, I found this\r\non one of the bookshelves.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_c_04a

entries.text: While I was here in the entrance hall, digging\nthrough my dad’s research reports, I found this\r\non one of the bookshelves.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_c_04b

entries.text: This book was so precious to my mom that she\neven kept a copy of it in the lighthouse lab...\r\nThe Scarlet Book... That’s what it’s called, right?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_c_05a

entries.text: This book was so precious to my dad that he\neven kept a copy of it in the lighthouse lab...\r\nThe Violet Book... That’s what it’s called, right?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_c_05b

entries.text: This is my first time really reading the bits that\naren’t about the Herba Mystica—they’re amazing![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_c_06

entries.text: I mean, it all sounds super fake, but it’s got all\nthese cool pictures and it’s real fun to read![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_c_07

entries.text: Like, look at this entry here![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_c_08

entries.text: The text on this page is all smudged and blurry in\nevery copy of this book I’ve ever seen.\c\nSeems kinda suspicious, right?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_c_09

entries.text:
’Course, the whole book is full of unbelievable
stories, the Herba Mystica being one of them.
But they turned out to be real...\c
And after everything we saw in Area Zero—well,
makes it hard to say it’s all nonsense, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_c_10

entries.text: In fact, I think it might’ve been this book that\nmade my mom want to become a researcher.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_c_11a

entries.text: In fact, I think it might’ve been this book that\nmade my dad want to become a researcher.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_c_11b

entries.text: I bet she got so fixated with the ancient Pokémon\nshe read about in here that it made her want to\r\nsee one for herself.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_c_12a

entries.text: I bet he got so fixated with the future Pokémon\nhe read about in here that it made him want to\r\nsee one for himself.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_c_12b

entries.text: Wait, hold on... Isn’t my mom’s time machine the\nwhole reason the ancient Pokémon ended up here\r\nin the first place?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_c_13a

entries.text: Wait, hold on... Isn’t my dad’s time machine the\nwhole reason the future Pokémon ended up here\r\nin the first place?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_c_13b

entries.text: This book is from way before she made the time\nmachine, but it mentions ancient Pokémon.\c\nIsn’t that kinda...weird?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_c_14a

entries.text: This book is from way before he made the time\nmachine, but it mentions future Pokémon.\c\nIsn’t that kinda...weird?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_c_14b

entries.text: Oh well! I’m sure it’s all just made up anyway![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_c_16

entries.text: But my mom believed that nonsense—and even\nmanaged to make it a reality.\c\nI guess she really was something![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_c_17a

entries.text: But my dad believed that nonsense—and even\nmanaged to make it a reality.\c\nI guess he really was something![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_c_17b

entries.text: I’m gonna learn from h[VAR 0x1107(00FF,0202)]eris example and start\ngiving it my all, too.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_c_18

entries.text: I’ve got something I gotta do now, but I’ll see\nyou around, little buddy![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: kizuna_friend_c_19
